text: Before arriving near {Place}, {Name} spent eleven years escorting surveyors. When crowds blocked the work, the officer called a halt and heard complaints, then asked people to clear the route so surveying could resume.
self_review: Eleven years escorting surveyors explain the habit of stopping to hear a crowd before continuing. The officer listens to get the work moving, without a claim that complaints were resolved or land restored. The passage fits disputed livelihoods without specifying their cause.
